title.zh: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
title.en: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat

current_state.zh: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's 31st annual Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions included Bitcoin for the first time, projecting a 10% compound annual return over 10–15 years — above its 7.5% for U.S. large-cap stocks and 5.5% for gold — while flagging 55% annualized volatility, excluding BTC from its main portfolio models, and rejecting the currency-debasement bull case.
